zoe: quick sync: deciding on required field treatment for the new integration form. options: asterisk only, small 'Required' chip, or hover-to-expand text. thoughts? :thinking_face:
alan: asterisk is compact but disappears at 200% zoom. prefer a small visually-hidden 'Required' text that reveals on focus + a subtle glyph always visible
jeri: +1 to reveal-on-focus. mobile is tight though. show glyph only on <=420px, full text on larger screens. keep aria-required on the control
samira: accessibility note: if you reveal text on focus, ensure it doesn't shift layout (use absolute overlay) and that `aria-describedby` references the revealed copy when shown
zoe: good call. implementation plan: CSS ::after glyph by default, on :focus or :hover swap to inline text without reflow. devs: avoid placeholder-based cues
alan: error strategy: inline messages for per-field errors, but a compact top banner with anchors when there are 3+ errors or cross-field problems. banner should read "3 errors prevent saving" and link to first invalid field
jeri: also auto-focus the first invalid field and announce error count with role=alert for screen readers
samira: deletion flow: current modal uses checkbox "I understand". propose risk-based confirmations: low-risk items -> destructive CTA + undo toast; high-risk/prod -> typed confirm + list of linked resources. show size/flag in modal header
zoe: agree. typed confirm requires clear label, live region for mismatch, autocomplete="off" and immediate focus when modal opens
alan: dev note: server should decide tier (size/flag). client shows appropriate modal and enforces typed confirm if required. also surface repercussions (snapshots, pipelines) in a collapsible section
zoe: ok i'll mock desktop + compact mobile variants and include an accessibility acceptance checklist (aria-required, aria-describedby, aria-invalid, role=alert, focus-first-invalid, undo toast behavior). will post mocks shortly
